name: Continuity Social Hub
intent: A whole-ecosystem social hub organized around movement between referents, people, systems, and time rather than around any one application such as school, tasks, or calendar.

witnesses.notes: Reply, mention, quote/repost, and thread mechanics expose OPEN/PING/REPLY/ECHO/BRANCH relations.
Root posts, nested discussion, and reposting preserve source while opening a new audience/context.
One activity surface aggregates unlike movement types while preserving their distinctions and source context.
Open conversations can remain conversational or move into scoped work without requiring the conversation surface to become the work system.
Internal movement bank supplies platform-neutral movement anchors.

layout.shape: feed-first social hub with persistent movement rail, current front, threaded/cross-boundary movement, and supporting sources below
layout.source_treatment: source systems remain visible as provenance labels, not page silos
layout.branching: child movement may visually indent or thread while retaining parent context
layout.return_paths: replies, reopened items, and returned handoffs should visibly point back to their referent

controls.composer: single contextual composer may open notes/tasks/calendar/handoffs by selected movement type rather than separate app dashboards
controls.filters: movement type, source system, actor, unread/current
controls.quick_actions: reply, react, branch, handoff, resolve, reopen

surface.cards: feed entries rather than dashboard metric cards
surface.color: neutral base; movement/source chips carry restrained functional differentiation

motion.rule: new movement may enter the feed without decorative animation or attention theft

avoid: school-first navigation on the ecosystem homepage
one card per subsystem as the primary information architecture
flattening every movement into a task
notification red-dot noise without an admitted relation
social engagement scores, follower counts, streaks, or gamification
hiding source provenance when movement crosses systems
ornamental AI gradients, glow, or excessive glass effects
adaptation_rules: Treat Online School, Personal Operations, Calendar, Factory, research, jobs, and future systems as sources into the same movement hub.
Preserve source-system ownership even when entries share one feed.
Use the movement anchor bank as the interaction grammar.
Calendar contributes time anchors; it does not become the homepage organizing model.
A discussion may become a task/handoff/issue-like object only through an explicit movement such as HANDOFF.
SILENCE is displayable as an observed absence window but must not be styled as blame or failure.
REOPEN should reconnect to prior lineage rather than render as an unrelated new item.

review.notes: Main ecosystem surface provenance. Replaces day_attention_ops_v1 for runtime/http only; the older day-attention template remains valid for narrower person-day surfaces.
